metrics.meanWealth: Sum current agent.wealth divided by numAgents, rounded2decimals; zero for no agents.
metrics.agentMeanTimeToLive: Mean agent.findTimeToLive(True), capped by age, rounded2decimals; zero for no agents.
metrics.meanAgeAtDeath: Mean agent.age over self.deadAgents for that update, rounded2decimals; zero if none. deadAgents cleared afterward.

limits: Equal time weighting of recorded per-step metrics; not event-weighted pooling of individual deaths.
